_comment: Fast LongMemEval subset for a quick memory-recall signal.
Same dataset/revision/split/mode as the full run, so the subset is a
strict subsample of it rather than a different measurement.
limit=30 is reservoir-sampled (Algorithm R) across the WHOLE pinned split
with a fixed seed, so category proportions are preserved in expectation.
A hand-picked first-N would bias toward the split's leading categories.
Arithmetic: measured median wall_seconds/task across 27 archived lmeval
and recall runs is 38s, so 30 tasks ~= 19 minutes on the local 8B, inside
the 10-20 minute target. At the 115s tail worst case 30 tasks ~= 58min.
